Ivy R: hi all, about to open my first PR. quick rules recap please: branch name, draft vs ready, required CI checks, and who to ping for api changes?
Devex Bot: welcome Ivy! Branches: feat/, fix/, chore/. Include ticket e.g. feat/INC-210-short-desc. Draft for WIP. Mark ready when tests pass locally and description has testing steps. CI: ci/lint, ci/unit. link: https://git.redwood.ai/CONTRIBUTING.md
Leo H: for API changes ping @Mira J and add `area/api` label. tiny PRs preferred (<300 LOC). run `pre-commit run --all-files` and include example curl snippets in the PR body.
Mira J: add an API changelog entry if public surface changed and include contract notes. if rolling out, mention rollout plan and feature-flag requirements.
Ivy R: thanks! will push a draft and drop the link here for a sanity check :thumbsup:
